title: .kritik.yaml
description: A repository's kritik configuration, read from the merge base. See docs/repository-config.md.

enabled.description: false stops reviews, follow-ups and indexing; true cannot turn a disabled repository on.

mode.description: How the repository is reviewed, one of the admin's allow.modes.

agent.description: An agentic review's limits, each at most the admin's allow.agent bound.

commands.description: Commands the agent may run, a subset of the admin's allow.commands.

settle.description: How long a new head waits before its review starts, at most the admin's allow.settle.

filter.description: A CEL expression over pr, ANDed with the admin's filter.

ignore.description: Path globs added to the admin's ignore list.

onlyPaths.description: Skip a pull request only when every changed path matches one of these.

instructions.description: Files appended to the reviewer's instructions, after the admin's.

paths.description: Include the file only when a changed path matches one of these.

requireSuggestedFix.description: true requires a suggested fix on every finding; false cannot lift the admin's requirement.

minSeverity.description: The least severe finding posted inline; blocking findings always are.

thoroughness.description: What the reviewer reports: thorough, anything a maintainer could act on, or focused, only what would stop the review.

context.description: Files that explain the code, added after the admin's.

paths.description: Name the file only when a changed path matches one of these.

duration.description: A Go duration, such as 30s, 5m or 1h30m.

path.description: A path relative to the repository root.

glob.description: A doublestar glob, such as docs/** or **/*.sql.
